narrative.overview:
The site is a near-black workshop floor where finished work assembles out of square brand-coloured blocks. Everything rests on a deep ground (#0A0B10) under a hairline drafting grid (64px cells, 1px white lines at 5.5% opacity, vignetted toward the edges) that glides slowly left-to-right on a shallow ~12° rise (9px/s, swaying ±6°, never vertical, sub-pixel smooth) and lags the scroll at 0.25× for parallax; one fixed layer behind every dark section, still under reduced motion. The two brand colours from the Matterpixel M, electric blue and hot magenta, never paint a band. They show up as light (blurred pools behind the proof), as edges (gradient hairlines and borders), and as pixel blocks (the eyebrow dot, the light edge, the closing M). The page reads as one dark field broken by three warm-paper beats (Founder, Engagement models, FAQ).

Density is editorial rather than dashboard: one 1200px container, generous 120px section rhythm on desktop, left-aligned sentence-case headings, and proof (real builds in browser frames, measured Lighthouse scores) carrying the visual weight in place of illustration. Motion is the signature. Pixel blocks assemble the signature moments (hero build, stack pixels, closing M); a blue→magenta light edge carries the transitions (section seams, the package sweep); every entrance settles on one expo curve.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground under the drifting parallax grid; three light beats on the homepage (Founder, Engagement models, FAQ), placed where the page turns from showing to reading or deciding; /services adds Build your stack.
Brand colour as light, edge and pixel, never as a fill.
One heading pattern: a magenta pixel and an uppercase eyebrow above a left-aligned H2.
Inter Tight for words, Avenir Heavy for buttons and numerals.
Pixel-block motion grammar with a static fallback for every effect.

rules.name: The Light, Edge and Pixel Rule
rules.body: Blue and magenta appear as blurred light pools (blur 120 to 140px at 15 to 25% alpha), 1px gradient edges, or square blocks. A section, band or full-width panel is never filled with either. Small solid fills are allowed only on interactive state (a selected chip, a selected card's icon) and on the primary button.

rules.name: The Two Beats Rule
rules.body: The page is dark by default. A section flips to Warm Paper only where the page turns from showing to reading or deciding: on the homepage the Founder strip, Engagement models and FAQ; on /services, Build your stack. Never strict alternation. Light sections are plain Warm Paper with no grid: the grid belongs to the dark ground. Light sections re-scope the same tokens, so components never carry a light/dark variant of their own.

rules.name: The Lifted Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue text on dark uses Periwinkle Ink, never raw Electric Blue, except at display size.

rules.name: The One Heading Rule
rules.body: Every section H2 sits under the eyebrow (magenta pixel plus uppercase label) in the Headline style. This eyebrow is a confirmed user decision for this site and applies to H2s only; nothing above an H3.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Inter Tight speaks; Avenir Heavy counts and acts. Avenir never sets a sentence, and Inter Tight never sets a price or a button label.

rules.name: The Blue Light Under Work Rule
rules.body: Only real work (a browser frame holding a build) gets the blue-tinted float. Everything else uses neutral black shadow.

dos: **Do** set every page section on the night ground over the drifting grid (never a second texture on top), and flip to Warm Paper only for a working or reading beat.
**Do** lead every section H2 with the magenta-pixel uppercase eyebrow (0.75rem, 0.16em tracking) and keep the H2 left-aligned, sentence case, in the Headline clamp.
**Do** use Periwinkle Ink for blue text on dark.
**Do** set prices, stats and scores in Avenir Heavy with tabular figures, and Lighthouse scores in Lighthouse Green.
**Do** build new motion from the page's three materials (pixel blocks, the light edge, the expo settle) and ship a static or fade fallback under reduced motion.
**Do** keep proof in browser frames with the blue float, and keep content visible without script.
donts: **Don't** fill a section, band or full-width panel with brand blue or magenta; use light pools, gradient edges and pixel blocks.
**Don't** centre section headings or put an eyebrow or kicker above an H3.
**Don't** introduce a second heading style for H2s or hand-set a new eyebrow treatment.
**Don't** invent a second entrance style: section entrances go through data-reveal and lib/useReveal.ts.
**Don't** round the pixel marks; squares stay square.
**Don't** use raw Electric Blue for body-size text on dark.
